title: ReVA: A Region-Aware Visual Assistant for Visually Grounded Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2608.28707v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet they continue to struggle with questions requiring precise spatial reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. These limitations often manifest as object, attribute, and spatial hallucinations, where models generate confident but visually unsupported responses due to insufficient region-level and fine-grained visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose ReVA, a region-aware VQA model that employs a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 Vision Transformer (ViT) and a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct large language model (LLM) connected through a dual bridge that aligns both whole-image and region-level representations with the LLM's embedding space. translated_title: ReVA：面向视觉定位问答的区域感知视觉助手
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型在视觉问答任务中取得了显著进展，但在需要精确空间推理和细粒度视觉理解的问题上仍然表现不佳。这些局限性通常表现为对象、属性和空间幻觉，即由于缺乏充分的区域级和细粒度视觉定位，模型会生成看似自信但缺乏视觉依据的回答。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了ReVA，一个区域感知的视觉问答模型。该模型采用冻结的CLIP ViT-L/14视觉Transformer和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct大语言模型，并通过双桥接结构将整幅图像和区域级表示与LLM的嵌入空间对齐。其中，图像桥接将最终Transformer块的特征映射为图像token；区域桥接则将来自ViT各块之间增强的中间特征的裁剪特征进行映射，从而利用早期的纹理信息和后期的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出区域感知视觉问答模型ReVA，通过双桥接结构将CLIP视觉特征的整图级与区域级表示同时对齐到大语言模型的嵌入空间，从而缓解视觉问答中的对象、属性和空间幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: ReVA is a region-aware VQA model that aligns both whole-image and region-level CLIP visual representations with an LLM's embedding space through a dual bridge, mitigating object, attribute, and spatial hallucinations in visually grounded question answering.
